'''Carrallanger Teleport''' requires a [[Magic]] level of 84 to cast. It teleports the caster to the [[Graveyard of Shadows]] (known in ancient times as [[Carrallanger]]) in level 19 [[Wilderness]].

As with all [[Ancient Magicks]] spells, the quest [[Desert Treasure I]] must be completed to cast this spell.

This teleport is popular for players who wish to kill [[green dragon]]s, as they are located very close to the teleport spot, and can greatly increase kills and profit per hour.
